TRAFFIC ADVISORY 

Traffic movement will remain suspended on Roshnara Road (Burf Khana to Kunji Lassi Wala) due to ongoing DMRC tunneling work at Pul Bangash Metro Station.

📍Heavy vehicles, buses & four-wheelers diverted
📍 Use alternate routes via Lala Jagannath Marg
📍Avoid the stretch to prevent delays
📢 Stay updated via Delhi Traffic Police channels

#DPTrafficAdvisory

TRAFFIC ADVISORY

In connection with Delhi Premier League-2025 matches, traffic movement around Arun Jaitley Stadium will be affected from 2 PM to 12 AM, 02.08.2025 to 31.08.2025.

📍Avoid JLN Marg & BSZ Marg
📍 No general parking near the stadium
📍Use designated entry gates & follow parking rules
📍Plan your travel in advance

#DPTrafficAdvisory
